description: Infringement (on-the-spot fine) amounts for parking offences. Amount = penaltyUnits × the Victorian penalty unit value for the financial year. Schedule 6 of the Road Safety (General) Regulations 2019 sets the base; councils may fix a higher amount for the cheaper items (reg 66 note; Road Safety Act 1986 s 87(4)) — City of Melbourne charges 0.5 units for the 0.2-unit items.

sources.note: Road Safety (General) Regulations 2019, S.R. No. 88/2019, Version 026 as at 1 Nov 2026, reg 66 + Schedule 6 (Sch. 6 last amended by S.R. No. 181/2026)
Gazette S 234, 5 May 2026: penalty unit $209.10 from 1 July 2026
'Parking fines range from $104 to $209 for the 2026-27 financial year'

verification.checkedBy: authorised PDF v026 (Schedule 6 rows) + Gazette/Justice for unit values
verification.notes: Court maximums in the Road Rules themselves (e.g. 3 penalty units for no stopping) are not what a ticket costs; Schedule 6 is.

councilMinimumUnits.description: Councils that have fixed 0.5 units for the 0.2-unit items under s 87(4). Unknown councils fall back to the schedule amount and the app says so.
